description: This file defines the 'tr2_tgt_normal' tracing target for the Trace2 subsystem, including initialization, terminator, and various event logging functions like version, start, exit, signal, command execution, and counters, as well as handling the output formatting and writing to a trace destination.

methods.name: int fn_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the normal trace target, configuring whether to include brief fields in logs based on environment variable.

methods.name: void fn_term(void)
methods.description: Terminates the trace by disabling the trace destination.

methods.name: void normal_fmt_prepare(const char * file,int line,struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Prepares a line buffer for trace output, optionally including timestamp and file:line info.

methods.name: void normal_io_write_fl(const char * file,int line,const struct strbuf * buf_payload)
methods.description: Writes a formatted line to the trace destination.

methods.name: void fn_version_fl(const char * file,int line)
void fn_start_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Logs the start event with command arguments.

methods.name: void fn_exit_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int code)
methods.description: Logs the process exit with elapsed time and exit code.

methods.name: void fn_signal(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int signo)
methods.description: Logs a signal event with elapsed time and signal number.

methods.name: void fn_atexit(uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute,int code)
methods.description: Logs an atexit event with elapsed time and code.

methods.name: void maybe_append_string_va(struct strbuf * buf,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Appends formatted string to buffer if format string is non-empty.

methods.name: void fn_error_va_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Logs an error message with optional formatted string.

methods.name: void fn_command_path_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * pathname)
void fn_command_ancestry_fl(const char * file,int line,const char ** parent_names)
void fn_command_name_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * name,const char * hierarchy)
void fn_command_mode_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * mode)
void fn_alias_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * alias,const char ** argv)
void fn_child_start_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,const struct child_process * cmd)
void fn_child_exit_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,int cid,int pid,int code,uint64_t us_elapsed_child)
void fn_child_ready_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,int cid,int pid,const char * ready,uint64_t us_elapsed_child)
void fn_exec_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,int exec_id,const char * exe,const char ** argv)
void fn_exec_result_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,int exec_id,int code)
methods.description: Logs execution result with exit code.

methods.name: void fn_param_fl(const char * file,int line,const char * param,const char * value,const struct key_value_info * kvi)
void fn_repo_fl(const char * file,int line,const struct repository * repo)
void fn_printf_va_fl(const char * file,int line,uint64_t us_elapsed_absolute UNUSED,const char * fmt,va_list ap)
methods.description: Logs formatted messages via variable argument list.

methods.name: void fn_timer(const struct tr2_timer_metadata * meta,const struct tr2_timer * timer,int is_final_data)
void fn_counter(const struct tr2_counter_metadata * meta,const struct tr2_counter * counter,int is_final_data)
